items: More space in the music: fewer parts playing at once in the grooves, a bigger reverb with crisp hits, and echoes that bounce left and right
The xylophone now plays chords and arpeggios in many genres, with a darker, lower one in the gentle start
The singer sings three-part harmonies under the grooves
Claps and finger snaps on the backbeat instead of a snare drum in most genres
Drums and bass sit bigger in the mix, and the whole thing is wider
The xylophone and finger snaps are now loud enough to hear
Finger snaps and claps now take turns: snaps in the lighter stretches, claps when the music is full
